snippet.title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino releases on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch in spring 2027!

A fox girl and her frog companion are stranded on a mysterious island wrapped in darkness, lit only by flickering lights. Torii gates, lantern-lit stalls, and neon signs color the shadows, but something is lurking close behind.

Explore the island, talk with its inhabitants, and kindle light within shrines to open new paths. Can you escape the oni that hunt in the night?

#IndieWorld #Kitsune #TheJourneyofAdashino
